slides.title: Mapping a Startup

content_blocks.block_data: Unit 2 · Mind Mapping and Creative Thinking Techniques · 120 minutes · studio · COs 109.4, 109.2

slides.speaker_notes: Studio session. Warm-up: What Must Exist. Do not lecture past 15 minutes.

slides.title: The one idea

content_blocks.block_data: A startup is not an idea. It is a list of things that must all exist at the same time.

slides.speaker_notes: Say it once. Do not elaborate on the slide — elaborate out loud.

slides.title: Why it matters

block_data.body: Offering, customer, channel, money, people, legal, technology. Four to seven of these become the main branches.

block_data.lead: The map exposes what you have not thought about
block_data.body: A thin branch is not a small problem; it is an unexamined one.

slides.speaker_notes: Four beats across two slides. Fifteen minutes for all of it.

slides.title: What to do with it

block_data.body: The startup is either the digital version of what your owner already does, or the adjacent thing they could start.
Central image, one word per line, curved branches, landscape.

slides.speaker_notes: Four beats across two slides. Fifteen minutes for all of it.

slides.title: Today you will

content_blocks.block_data: Create a mind map for a technology startup idea, visually breaking down the components needed to launch it.

slides.title: To close

block_data.head: Pitch
block_data.body: Three minutes. The person, the stuck, the idea, the picture, the ask.

block_data.head: Critique
block_data.body: I like… / I wish… / What if… — the idea, never the person.

block_data.head: Idea log
block_data.body: One page. Silent. Box 4 is the one you read again in week 15.

slides.speaker_notes: If time runs short, cut the input — never the pitch. The pitch is how CO 109.2 is attained.
